name: slovenia-income-tax
description: Slovenian personal income tax (dohodnina) for tax year 2026 under ZDoh-2 as amended to ZINR (Uradni list RS 40/25). Covers residents and non-residents, the five-band scale (16%, 26%, 33%, 39%, 50%) with the 2026 indexed bands, the general allowance of EUR 5,551.93 and its taper for total income up to EUR 17,766.18, dependants and other allowances, capital income at 25% with 20% and 15% after 5 and 10 years and exemption after 15, rent at 25% with 10% standard costs, sole proprietors (s.p.) on normed expenses under ZPZR for 2026 (two-year average revenue tests of EUR 120,000, 85,000 or 50,000; final tax 20% then 35%) as a pointer, the informative calculation (informativni izračun) and its 15-day objection, advance tax and fines. Trigger on: dohodnina, informativni izračun, ugovor, splošna olajšava, Doh-KDVP, Doh-Div, rent tax Slovenia. Out of scope: si-cross-border (7% new-resident relief, non-residents), slovenia-payroll, slovenia-social-contributions, si-corporate-income-tax, slovenia
